WeWill Keep Enduring
(Matthew 24:13)
1. How can we endure
When trials come, as Jesus said?
Through his pain he saw
The joy of better things ahead.
God's promise, God's justice,
Were thoughts on which he fed.
(CHORUS)
We need to have endurance.
Our faith we must defend.
His love is our assurance.
So we will keep enduring to the end.
2. Though the passing years
May bring us sorrow, bring us pain;
There beyond the tears,
We see the life that we can gain.
To be there, feel free there,
Determined we remain.
(CHORUS)
We need to have endurance.
Our faith we must defend.
His love is our assurance.
So we will keep enduring to the end.
3. We will not give up
Nor see the need for doubt or fear.

Until Jehovah's day is here.

That time is very near.

150 Hãy tha thứ
(Thi thiên 86:5)
1. Giê-hô-va thật cao cả,
ngài hy sinh chính Con một yêu
cho chúng ta hôm nay được cứu chuộc,

Người ăn năn thật lòng đến với Cha
cầu xin Cha rộng lượng thứ tha

xót thương và xóa tội lỗi mình.
2. Ta chắc chắn được thương xót
một khi theo tấm gương của Cha.
Luôn cảm thông, bao dung ngày mỗi ngày,
mau thứ tha cho người lỗi lầm.
Chẳng cưu mang hờn giận, oán trách ai
mà yêu thương, rộng lượng bỏ qua.
Và ta hãy thật lòng quý mến nhau,
giữ ân tình thắm nồng mãi còn.
3. Thương xót, tính thật cao quý,
vậy nên ta gắng trau dồi thêm.
Khi xót thương, xua tan mọi oán giận,
bao đắng cay trong lòng chẳng còn.
Cùng noi gương tuyệt vời Đấng Chí Cao,
ngài yêu thương hoàn hảo biết bao,
thì ta sẽ thật sự biết thứ tha,
khiến vui lòng Chúa và thỏa nguyện.
(Cũng xem Mat 6:12; Ê-phê 4:32; Cô 5:15).
en: SONG 130
Be Forgiving
(Psalm 86:5)
1. Lovingly Jehovah
Made provision through his Son
For our sins to be forgiven
And for death to be undone.
If we truly are repentant,
His forgiveness we can claim
On the basis of Christ's ransom,
Asking pardon in his name.
2. We receive such mercy
When we act like God above
And forgive each other freely,
Showing empathy and love.
Putting up with one another,
Putting hurtfulness away;
Showing honor to our brother,
Showing love's surpassing way.
3. Mercy is a virtue
That we all should cultivate.
It will keep us from resentment,
From the bitterness of hate.
When we imitate Jehovah,
Who is unsurpassed in love,
We will truly be forgiving;
We will be like God above.
(See also Matt. 6:12; Eph. 4:32; Col. 3:13.)

en: SONG 131
“What God Has Yoked Together”
(Matthew 19:5, 6)
1. With dignity and joy,
A threefold cord is bound.
With God and men to witness,
These sacred vows resound.
(CHORUS 1)
He vowed before Jehovah
To love her from the heart.
“What God has yoked together,
Let no man put apart.”
2. They both have searched God's Word
To learn to do his will,
And now they seek his blessing,
Their promise to fulfill.
(CHORUS 2)
She vowed before Jehovah
To love him from the heart.
“What God has yoked together,
Let no man put apart.”
(See also Gen. 2:24; Eccl. 4:12; Eph. 5:22-33.)

Now We Are One
(Genesis 2:23, 24)
1. This is at last bone of my bone,
Flesh of my flesh; now I'm not alone.
God has provided a partner,
Someone to call my own.
Now we are one; now there can be
Blessings to share for you and for me.
As man and woman together,
We are a family.

As he shows the way,
Unfailing love we'll display.
As we have vowed, so may it be.
Seasons of joy, may we come to see.
Oh, may we honor Jehovah,
And may you always be my love.
(See also Gen. 29:18; Eccl. 4:9, 10; 1 Cor. 13:8.)

en: SONG 133
Worship Jehovah During Youth
(Ecclesiastes 12:1)
1. Precious to God, we are daughters and sons,
Giving our strength as his faithful young ones.
Loving attention to us he will give,
Blessing our days for as long as we live.
2. Honoring parents who care for our lives
Helps us express what we're feeling inside.
Then we find favor with God and with men,
Drawing us close to Jehovah, our Friend.
3. May we remember our God in our youth,
Growing each day in our love of the truth.
Giving our best to our God, we will bring
Joy to the heart of Jehovah, our King.
(See also Ps. 71:17; Lam. 3:27; Eph. 6:1-3.)

154 Con cái là sản nghiệp từ Đức Chúa Trời
(Thi thiên 127:5-5)
1. Trẻ thơ là một sản nghiệp vô giá,
chính cha mẹ nhận quà này từ Giê-hô-va.
Hỡi bao mẹ cha, hãy nhớ và chớ quên
chăm lo, hướng dẫn, chở che người con.
Biết rõ con là phần thưởng từ Cha xuống.
Giê-hô-va là nguồn của sự sống, yêu thương,
đấng ban cha mẹ cách dạy con khôn lớn.
Hãy theo đường ngài khôn sáng không gì bằng.
(ĐIỆP KHÚC)
Chúa giao trách nhiệm, hỡi ai làm mẹ cha,
bạn được chăm sóc con quý Cha ban.
Hãy luôn gắng dạy trẻ thơ học theo Chúa,
quà cao quỹ nhất với con đời đời.
2. Hỡi cha mẹ, lòng bạn cần ghi khắc
những chỉ mà Lời Giê-hô-va đã hướng dẫn.
Hãy ân cần khuyên, uốn nắn, dạy dỗ con,
cho con biết cách sống theo luật Cha.
Nhắc nhở con vào mọi dịp, mọi nơi chốn,
cả khi đi đường, ở nhà hay lúc vui chơi,
đề con sau này nhớ lời khuyên Kinh Thánh,
bước đi trung kiên, bao phước ân, thỏa nguyện.
(ĐIỆP KHÚC)
Chúa giao trách nhiệm, hỡi ai làm mẹ cha,
bạn được chăm sóc con quý Cha ban.
Hãy luôn gắng dạy trẻ thơ học theo Chúa,
quà cao quỹ nhất với con đời đời.
(Cũng xem Phục 6:6, 7; Ê-phê 6:A;17Ti4:16).

en: SONG 134
Children Are a Trust From God
1. When a man becomes a father
And a woman has a child of her own,
They share a trust, they must remember,
That is not theirs, not theirs alone.
The gift they share is from Jehovah;
Of life and love he is the one true Source.
To parents he gives sure direction
That they may follow the wisest course.
(CHORUS)
A sacred trust you have been given;
A precious life is in your hands.
You can bestow the greatest favor;
Instruct your child in God's commands.
2. All the words God has commanded—
They must always prove to be on your heart.
These words you'll speak to sons and daughters;
This is your trust, this is your part.
To them you'll speak along your roadway,
When you rise up and when you are at rest.
In years to come, may they remember,
May they be faithful, may they be blessed.
(CHORUS)
A sacred trust you have been given;
A precious life is in your hands.
You can bestow the greatest favor;
Instruct your child in God's commands.
(See also Deut. 6:6, 7; Eph. 6:4; 1 Tim. 4:16.)

de: Kinder — ein kostbares Geschenk von Jehova
Endlich sieht ihr Kind das Licht dieser Welt!
Welch ein Geschenk von Gott Jehova!
Sein Wort für Eltern Rat enthält.
Auf ihrer Reise durch das Leben
Gott zeigt den Weg, er seine Weisheit schenkt.
Als Quell des Lebens und der Liebe
Gott Eltern leitet, er sanft sie lenkt.
Legt Gottes Wort ins Herz der Kinder,
prägt es mit Liebe ihnen ein.
Sie sind so kostbar für Jehova,
sollt den Kindern ihr erklärn jederzeit.
Wenn euer eignes Herz berührt ist,
ein gutes Vorbild ihr dann seid.
Ihr Leben liegt in euren Händen,
ihr Eltern, führt sie zu Jehova hin.
Legt Gottes Wort ins Herz der Kinder,
prägt es mit Liebe ihnen ein.
Sie sind so kostbar für Jehova,
fr: Les enfants sont un don sacré
1. Cet enfant blotti dans vos bras,
Qui vous balbutie « papa » et « maman »,
Ce doux trésor, ce petit d’homme,
C’est un cadeau de Jéhovah Dieu,
La seule Source d’amour et de vie,
Le meilleur Père et Guide qui soit.
Un don sacré est entre vos mains,
Accordez-lui le plus beau, le mieux :
2. Autrefois, Dieu a dit pour vous :
« Mes paroles, grave-les sur ton cœur.
C’est ta mission, c’est ton honneur.
Explique-les dès l’aube et au soir,
Quand tu chemines et quand tu es chez toi.
Que ton enfant les garde avec soin ;
Il restera sur la bonne voie. »
Un don sacré est entre vos mains,
Accordez-lui le plus beau, le mieux :

vi: BÀI HÁT 135
Đức Giê-hô-va mến gọi: ‘Hỡi con, hãy khôn ngoan!'
(Châm ngôn 27:11)
1. Nam thanh và nữ tú,
hãy trao dâng trọn lòng cho Cha;
kẻ thù hiện đang bêu xấu danh Cha
rồi phải nhận ra.
Con dâng trọn cho Cha tuổi thanh xuân,
trung tín đến cùng;
cả thế gian sẽ biết con muốn sống
làm đẹp lòng Cha.
(ĐIỆP KHÚC)
Hãy khôn ngoan con, làm cho Cha vui lòng
và quyết trung kiên cùng Cha suốt đời.
Con hãy tôn vinh Cha với cả tấm lòng,
ngợi khen Cha mãi bởi đường con chọn.
2. Mong con mừng vui bước mãi theo Cha,
chọn thờ tôn Cha.
Dẫu đường đời con vấp ngã,
tay Cha liền dìu con lên.
Xung quanh người quay lưng,
kẻ mưu gian, con chớ lo sợ
mà hãy tin chắc chắn Cha quý mến
và trợ lực con.
(ĐIỆP KHÚC)
Hãy khôn ngoan con, làm cho Cha vui lòng
và quyết trung kiên cùng Cha suốt đời.
Con hãy tôn vinh Cha với cả tấm lòng,
ngợi khen Cha mãi bởi đường con chọn.
(Cũng xem Phục 6:5; Truyền 11:9; Ê-sai 41:13).
zh_tw: 耶和華親切地說：「寶貝，你要有智慧！」
en: SONG 135
Jehovah's Warm Appeal: “Be Wise, My Son”
(Proverbs 27:11)
1. Young man and young woman,
do give your heart to me.
My foe who now taunts me
will then be made to see.
Your youth and devotion
to me you freely give;
You show all the world
that for me you really live.
(CHORUS)
Beloved son and precious daughter,
Be wise and make my heart rejoice,
That out of your own heart you serve me,
And offer praise by your own choice.
2. Rejoice and take pleasure
in giving me your all,
And though you may stumble,
I'll raise you if you fall.
No matter who fails you
or proves to be untrue,
Take comfort in knowing
I'll always cherish you.
(CHORUS)
Beloved son and precious daughter,
Be wise and make my heart rejoice,
That out of your own heart you serve me,
And offer praise by your own choice.
(See also Deut. 6:5; Eccl. 11:9; Isa. 41:13.)

vi: BÀI HÁT 136
“Phần thưởng trọn vẹn” từ Đức Giê-hô-va
1. Thật Cha Giê-hô-va hằng trung tín với bao người
trọn tâm thờ tôn Cha, không chuyển lay.
Chúa biết những anh chị vì kiên quyết bước theo ngài,
chịu nhiều điều mất mát hay khó nhọc.
Hỡi các anh chị em xưa giờ hy sinh thì luôn
tin chắc Chúa trên cao biết mọi điều.
Ngài sẽ xoa dịu ta và ban gấp bội phần hơn,
phần thưởng trong tương lai sống muôn đời.
(ĐIỆP KHÚC)
Cầu xin Cha ban trọn vẹn phần thưởng anh chị
vì Cha yêu thương, hiền từ, thương xót vô cùng.
Giê-hô-va vẫn luôn thành tín, chân thật.
Mình náu thân nơi Cha là trọn đời có bình an.
2. Đời ta nhiều lo toan tựa như những gánh mang nặng,
dường như đè trên vai muôn khó khăn.
Có lúc những ưu phiền bủa vây lấy trí tâm mình,
chịu đựng làm cho sức ta mỏi mệt.
Dẫu thế Cha từ nhân luôn kề bên an ủi ta,
kiên nhẫn lắng nghe bao tiếng cầu xin.
Thần khí Cha rộng ban, Lời Cha với anh chị em
trợ sức cho ta luôn bước theo ngài.
(ĐIỆP KHÚC)
Cầu xin Cha ban trọn vẹn phần thưởng anh chị
vì Cha yêu thương, hiền từ, thương xót vô cùng.
Giê-hô-va vẫn luôn thành tín, chân thật.
Mình náu thân nơi Cha là trọn đời có bình an.
(Cũng xem Quan 11:38-40; Ê-sai 41:10).
zh_tw: 耶和華必賜你十足賞賜
如經上所記，人為了好消息，
受家人反對，朋友冷眼以對，
他已賜給你百倍弟兄姐妹，
你決心投靠上帝翅膀下，
甘願付出一切來榮耀他，
上帝可靠、忠貞，必賜你福分。
但你不放棄，勇敢堅持到底，
他樂意聽你向他傾訴心意，
他賜力量、真理和弟兄情誼，
你決心投靠上帝翅膀下，
甘願付出一切來榮耀他，
上帝可靠、忠貞，必賜你福分。
en: SONG 136
“A Perfect Wage” From Jehovah
(Ruth 2:12)
1. Jehovah is faithful and fully aware
Of all those who serve him whole-souled.
He knows there are times their devotion and zeal
Result in their loss as foretold.
If you have left houses or fam'ly or friends,
Be sure that our God knows the sum.
He makes it up now with our dear brotherhood
And life in the new world to come.
(CHORUS)
May Jehovah reward what you have done.
May he provide a perfect wage for you.
May you find refuge beneath his wings.
Jehovah is faithful; Jehovah is true.
2. At times we may feel that our lot in this life
Has burdened us more than our share.
And sometimes it seems that the cares of the day
Are more than we're able to bear.
The God of all comfort takes note of your need;
You know he's the Hearer of prayer.
His Word and his spirit and true, loving friends
Will bring to you comfort and care.
(CHORUS)
May Jehovah reward what you have done.
May he provide a perfect wage for you.
May you find refuge beneath his wings.
Jehovah is faithful; Jehovah is true.
(See also Judg. 11:38-40; Isa. 41:10.)

de: 1. Jehova kennt jeden, der ihm freudig dient.
Er weiß, unser Herz für ihn schlägt.
Er sieht, wer verzichtet, er sieht, wer verliert.
Er merkt, mancher schwer daran trägt.
Ob Freunde, Familie, ob Häuser es sind,
Die Bruderschaft schenkt Gott uns liebevoll heut
Von Jehova bekommst du bald den Lohn.
Er heilt die Wunden, er macht alles neu.
Mit seinen Flügeln schenkt er dir Schutz.
Du kannst ihm vertrauen. Jehova ist treu.
2. Das Leben hält nicht immer Gutes bereit,
Die Sorgen des Alltags bedrücken uns oft,
Vertrau dich dem Gott allen Trostes doch an.
„Komm, sprich zu mir!“, lädt er dich ein.
Sein Wort, seinen Geist und auch Freunde er schenkt.
Dein Gott lässt dich niemals allein!
Von Jehova bekommst du bald den Lohn.
Er heilt die Wunden, er macht alles neu.
Mit seinen Flügeln schenkt er dir Schutz.
Du kannst ihm vertrauen. Jehova ist treu.
fr: 1. Jamais Dieu n’oublie tous ceux qui, vaillamment,
Le servent de toute leur âme,
Et qui, par leur foi et leur attachement,
Renoncent au confort et au calme.
Si tu as quitté champ, maison et parents,
Il t’offre des frères et des sœurs accueillants,
Sois béni sans fin par le Dieu du ciel !
Qu’il récompense tes actions, ton zèle !
Du Dieu qui ne ment pas, du seul Dieu fidèle.
2. Parfois, te sens-tu accablé par la vie ?
Dis-tu : « J’ai eu trop de malheurs » ?
Ou, jour après jour, sous le poids des soucis,
Dis-tu : « Je n’ai plus de vigueur » ?
Le Dieu qui console sait quand tu faiblis,
Sois sûr qu’il entend tes prières.
Sa force et la Bible et de tendres amis
Sois béni sans fin par le Dieu du ciel !
Qu’il récompense tes actions, ton zèle !
Du Dieu qui ne ment pas, du seul Dieu fidèle.
pl: 1. Jehowa jest wierny, On widzi i zna
On wie, że gdy co dzień gorliwie Go czczą,
to świat nie oszczędza im krzywd.
Kto traci przyjaciół czy bliskich, czy dom,
niech ufa, że widzi to Jah.
On w zborze dał mnóstwo i braci, i sióstr,
za twój wysiłek i ofiarny trud.
Jehowa jest wierny. Prawdziwy to Bóg.
2. Czasami to życie pozbawia cię sił
i w zamian niewiele chce dać.
zbyt ciężkie, byś poniósł je sam.
Bóg pragnie cię wesprzeć, rozumie twój ból
Z miłości dał Biblię i ducha, i zbór,
opieką otoczył cię swą. Niech Jehowa zapłatę hojną da
za twój wysiłek i ofiarny trud.
Jehowa jest wierny. Prawdziwy to Bóg.
cs: 1. Náš Bůh Jehova všechny své věrné zná,
co jej celou svou duší ctí.
On ví, že pro svou oddanost výlučnou
ať může za svým Bohem jít,
ten všech pokladů stokrát více dnes má
a v ráji bude věčně žít.
Kéž Bůh útěchy vidí lásku tvou,
bohatou odměnu on kéž ti dá.
Pod jeho křídly se můžeš skrýt,
vždyť náš Bůh je věrný, k nám všem lásku má.
2. Jsou chvíle, kdy nás v myšlenkách napadá:
Jak dál v proudu dní obstojím?
Když zas další den přinese trápení,
A rád pošle nám skutečné přátele
Kéž Bůh útěchy vidí lásku tvou,
bohatou odměnu on kéž ti dá.
Pod jeho křídly se můžeš skrýt,
vždyť náš Bůh je věrný, k nám všem lásku má.
hu: 1. Jah jól tudja azt, ki is szolgálja úgy,
S mint hű Atya látja: e lelkesedés
Ha kész voltál elhagyni házat, rokont,
s egy új világ vár, ne feledd!
Áldott légy, áldjon meg nagy Istenünk,
mert ő igaz bíránk, mert ő mindig hű.
2. Az életünk, jól tudjuk, nem gondtalan,
ma még annyi bajt hozhat ránk.
Úgy érezheted, gondod túl nagy teher,
Ám Jah vigaszt nyújt, hidd el, melletted áll,
Szent szelleme, bölcs Szava, számos barát:
ez mind kincset ér, ad erőt.
Áldott légy, áldjon meg nagy Istenünk,
mert ő igaz bíránk, mert ő mindig hű.
zh_cn: 耶和华必赐你十足赏赐
如经上所记，人为了好消息，
受家人反对，朋友冷眼以对，
他已赐给你百倍弟兄姐妹，
你决心投靠上帝翅膀下，
甘愿付出一切来荣耀他，
上帝可靠、忠贞，必赐你福分。
但你不放弃，勇敢坚持到底，
他乐意听你向他倾诉心意，
他赐力量、真理和弟兄情谊，
你决心投靠上帝翅膀下，
甘愿付出一切来荣耀他，
上帝可靠、忠贞，必赐你福分。

vi: BÀI HÁT 137
157... Những người nữ trung thành
1. Sa-ra, Ê-xơ-tê, Ru-tơ, Ma-ri, nhiều nữa,
tất cả là người tài đức, suốt đời luôn thủy chung;
hết tâm thờ Giê-hô-va, quyết trung thành tôn kính;
tạo danh tiếng thơm lừng, Thánh Kinh lưu lại đời sau.
Nhiều hơn nữa, biết bao người dù không ghi rõ,
Chúa yêu thương họ vô cùng, đội nữ trung thành của Cha.
2. Tính trung thành, nhân đức, can đảm, yêu thương, thành tín,
hết thảy đều là phẩm chất đáng được quỹ trọng thay,
nhắc cho mình luôn nhớ đến biết bao chị thuở trước.
Họ tài đức vô cùng, những gương cho mình theo bước.
Ngày nay có thêm gương nhiều chị trên khắp đất
vẫn luôn theo đường trung thành, được Chúa trân trọng, mến yêu.
3. Những mẹ, chị, em gái, bao vợ hay bao chị góa
đáng khen vì làm gương tốt, trách nhiệm luôn đảm đương.
Với tinh thần luôn khiêm tốn, vâng phục và tin kính,
chị em hãy vui mừng bởi Giê-hô-va ban phước.
Cầu xin Chúa ở bên cạnh dịu dàng chăm sóc,
giúp đức tin càng vững mạnh, chờ đón muôn vàn phước ân.
(Cũng xem Phi-líp 4:5; 1 Tỉ 2:9, 10; 1 Phi 5:4, 5).
ko: 충실한 그 이름 모두 다 아네.
확신 잃지 않아 상을 곧 받으리.
zh_tw: 忠心的女子，基督徒姐妹
都是古代賢慧忠貞的榜樣，
她們樂意遵行上帝的旨意，
表現堅強信心，留下了美名。
許多女子雖然不見經傳，
卻都忠貞不渝，蒙耶和華眷愛。
都是這些古代女子的美德，
她們的好品行深得人喜愛，
這些優秀婦女都堪作模範。
現代忠心的基督徒姐妹，
也立下好榜樣，值得效法、稱讚。
你都辛勤工作，努力盡本分。
心甘情願服從，謙卑又溫和，
不用擔心，你必得天父認可。
你是耶和華所關愛的人，
他必定幫助你，賜你未來福樂。
en: SONG 137
Faithful Women, Christian Sisters
(Romans 16:2)
1. Sarah and Esther, Mary, Ruth, and others—
All these were capable women, loyal wives.
Godly devotion was foremost in their lives.
They were faithful women, ones we know by name.
There were others favored by Jehovah;
Nameless in the record, their faith was just the same.
2. Goodness and courage, loyal love and kindness—
Lovable qualities in all humankind,
Virtues these excellent women bring to mind.
They were fine examples we appreciate.
In the same way now our Christian sisters
Show a faithful spirit we all can imitate.
3. Mothers and daughters, sisters, wives, and widows,
Willingly laboring, glad to do your part.
Modest your bearing, submissive is your heart,
Having God's approval, may you never fear.
Christian sisters, may Jehovah keep you
Firm in your conviction, your prize is drawing near.
(See also Phil. 4:3; 1 Tim. 2:9, 10; 1 Pet. 3:4, 5.)
de: 1. Sara und Esther, Ruth und auch Maria
liebten Jehova, den wahren Gott, so sehr.
Treu ihren Männern in Zeiten auch, die schwer.
Manche andre Frauen Gottes Wort nicht nennt.
Sie warn schön durch ihren starken Glauben;
sie sind nicht vergessen, Gott ihre Namen kennt.
Werte, die Gott gern sieht und die nie vergehn.
An treuen Frauen der Bibel wir sie sehn.
Wie viel Gutes uns ihr Beispiel zeigen kann!
Auch die vielen treuen Schwestern heute
ehren Gott Jehova. Ihr Vorbild regt uns an.
hingebungsvoll und mit Freude ihr Gott dient.
Ihr seid bescheiden, ihr habt euch Lob verdient.
An Jehovas Hand ihr immer sicher seid.
Liebe Schwestern, Gott wird euch belohnen
und er wird euch stärken, ja bis in Ewigkeit.
fr: 1. Ruth et Sara, Esther, Marie, Phébé, Anne... Toutes femmes avisées, dévouées compagnes,
Plus que leur vie aimaient Jéhovah leur Père.
Nous les connaissons pour leur foi exemplaire.
Mais bien d’autres eurent une foi aussi belle :
Chères anonymes remarquées dans le ciel.
Sont des vertus que l’humanité acclame,
Des qualités que ces nobles noms rappellent.
Si ces femmes sont pour nous tous des modèles,
Vous montrez l’exemple par votre foi constante.
3. Mères, ou épouses, ou veuves, ou filles, ou sœurs : femmes !
La faveur de Jéhovah est votre charme.
Vous le servez avec zèle et par amour.
Soumission et modestie sont vos atours.
Bien-aimées chrétiennes, que Dieu vous garde !
Qu’il vous récompense, vous donne la victoire !
pl: 1. Dzielna Estera, Sara, Rut i Maria —
przykład lojalnych żon i wierności wzór.
Zawsze trzymały się w życiu Bożych dróg.
To imiona kobiet dobrze znanych z Pism. Wiele innych miało więź z Jehową;
dla nas bezimienne, lecz znamy wiarę ich.
cechy te piękne są, tak ujmują nas.
Chcemy przejawiać je więc każdego dnia.
Te kobiety pod tym względem dały wzór.
Wiernie trwają w służbie i ceni to nasz Bóg.
3. Matki i córki, siostry, żony, wdowy —
szczodry, ofiarny duch dziś ozdabia was.
Ubiór z duchowych cech to prawdziwy skarb.
Bóg was kocha i do końca będzie strzegł.
wzmacnia waszą wiarę; nagroda zbliża się.
cs: 1. Sára a Ester, často o nich slýcháš,
krásné a statečné ve svém jednání. Získaly obě dvě Boží schválení.
Jejich jména dodnes každý dobře zná.
Ale Bůh měl rád i mnohé další,
jejichž pevná víra je velmi podobná.
S vírou vždy zůstaly pevné, odvážné.
V tísni a těžkostech byly rozvážné.
Mají stejnou víru a stejné smýšlení.
3. Svou laskavostí jste pro nás tak vzácné,
To se Bohu líbí, není proč se bát.
Jehova je s vámi a odmění vás rád.
hu: 1. Mária, Sára, Eszter, Ruth és más nők,
mind igaz feleség, hithű példakép. Áldották Jehovát, szívük érte élt,
nevük jól ismert, van róluk feljegyzés.
nevüket nem tudjuk, de hitük éppúgy élt.
2. Mély szeretet, hű szív és gyöngéd jóság,
mind igen nagy erény, érték Istentől.
Bár mi is szüntelen úgy dicsérnénk őt,
ahogy tették azt a hithű, bátor nők!
Ma is buzgón követi e mintát
ha szerény egy nő, az több mint ékes dísz.
tartsatok ki végig, oly közel már a díj!

她们乐意遵行上帝的旨意，
表现坚强信心，留下了美名。
许多女子虽然不见经传，
却都忠贞不渝，蒙耶和华眷爱。
都是这些古代女子的美德，
她们的好品行深得人喜爱，
这些优秀妇女都堪作模范。
现代忠心的基督徒姐妹，
也立下好榜样，值得效法、称赞。
你都辛勤工作，努力尽本分。
心甘情愿服从，谦卑又温和，

(Châm ngôn 16:51)

đã qua đi xuân thì.
Họ chịu đựng bao nỗi gian truân,
vẫn trung kiên cùng Cha.
Do tuổi cao nên sức tiêu hao,
có khi đơn lẻ bóng.

2. Giê-hô-va thương những cao niên

trải qua bao gian lao, hy sinh

en: SONG 138
Beauty in Gray-Headedness
(Proverbs 16:31)
1. Here with us are aged ones,
Those whose youth has passed.
Here among us they endure;
Still they're holding fast.
Loss of strength besets them all;
Loss of mates for some.
Father, please confirm their faith
In the life to come.
(CHORUS)
Father, you remember
How in faith they've run.
Give them your assurance;
May they hear, “Well done!”
2. Splendid is gray-headedness
Found in ways of right.
Beautiful are faithful ones
In Jehovah's sight.
May we always recognize
They were once young too.
Loyally they gave their best
When their strength was new.
(CHORUS)
Father, you remember
How in faith they've run.
Give them your assurance;
May they hear, “Well done!”

Hình dung cuộc sống bạn trong thế giới mới
(Khải huyền 21:1-5)
1. Nhìn đến tương lai bạn với tôi đây,
mặt đất nên mới, ta cùng nhau chung niềm vui.
Hình dung đến ngày Chúa ban tự do,
thỏa lòng, vui sướng, kẻ gian tham chẳng còn.
Bạn thấy ra sao? Hạnh phúc hay chăng?
Một thế giới mới mà Cha hứa nay thành.
Ngôi Cha lập nên vững và ban phước khắp nhân loại.
Nào ta đồng ca khen
Giê-hô-va hết tấm lòng ta:
(ĐIỆP KHÚC)
“Lạy Chúa Giê-hô-va, việc Chúa ôi tuyệt thay.
Hiển vinh, oai nghi thuộc riêng Cha đến muôn đời.
Cha ban mọi vật nên mới nhờ ngôi Nước Vua Giê-su.
Chúng con nguyện ca khen, tôn kính Chúa Tối Cao muôn năm”.
2. Nhìn thấy tương lai bạn với tôi đang
cùng sống trên đất, không buồn lo hay sầu đau.
Điều gây khiếp sợ biến tan từ đây.
Mọi vật nên mới đúng như Cha đã định.
Lều Giê-hô-va ngự giữa muôn dân.
Người khắp trên đất giờ vui hưởng an bình.
Bao nhiêu người an giấc từ muôn thuở, Chúa kêu gọi.
Họ vui gặp thân nhân,
cùng ta vang tiếng cảm tạ Cha:
(ĐIỆP KHÚC)
“Lạy Chúa Giê-hô-va, việc Chúa ôi tuyệt thay.
Hiển vinh, oai nghi thuộc riêng Cha đến muôn đời.
Cha ban mọi vật nên mới nhờ ngôi Nước Vua Giê-su.
Chúng con nguyện ca khen, tôn kính Chúa Tối Cao muôn năm”.
(Cũng xem Thi 37:10, 11; Ê-sai 65:17; Giăng 5:28; 2 Phi 3:13).

en: SONG 139
See Yourself When All Is New
(Revelation 21:1-5)
1. Just see yourself, just see me too;
Just see us all in a world that is new.
Think how you'll feel, how it will be,
To live in peace, to be truly free.
No evil one will then prevail;
Rule by our God cannot ever fail.
The time will have come for a new earthly start,
The song of our praises
will pour out from our heart:
(CHORUS)
“We thank you, our God, for all you have done.
All things are new by the rule of your Son.
The fullness of our heart overflows in our song;
All glory and honor and praise to you belong.”
2. Now see yourself, and see me too;
And look ahead to a world that is new.
No sight we see, no sound we hear
Will cause alarm or give rise to fear.
All has come true, just as he said;
Now over mankind, his tent is spread.
He now will awaken those sleeping in death;
Their voices will join ours with
ev'ry grateful breath:
(CHORUS)
“We thank you, our God, for all you have done.
All things are new by the rule of your Son.
The fullness of our heart overflows in our song;
All glory and honor and praise to you belong.”

1. Siehst du dich selbst im Paradies
und alles Schöne, was Gott uns verhieß?
Es wird nicht sein nur Träumerei,

Vom Bösen keine Spur zu sehn,
durch Gottes Herrschaft wird dies geschehn.
Das wirkliche Leben dann jeder genießt.
„Jehova, hab Dank! Du machst alles neu.
Dein König Jesus regiert, ist dir treu.
Mit jedem Atemzug fühlen wir uns befreit.
Nur du, unser Gott, verdienst Ruhm in Ewigkeit!“
2. Siehst du dich selbst im Paradies,

Kein Anblick mehr, der uns entsetzt,

„Jehova, hab Dank! Du machst alles neu.

Sự sống vĩnh cửu là đây!
(Giăng 5:16)
1. Bằng đức tin, bạn có thấy chăng?
Người khắp nơi chung sống hiền hòa.
Buồn than, đau đớn biến tan luôn.
Xóa đi kỷ niệm đau buồn.
(ĐIỆP KHÚC)
Hát xướng, reo vui trong lòng!
Hướng đến tương lai Cha ban,
ngày ta hân hoan nói trong tâm:
“Sống vui bất tận nay thành!”
2. Người khắp nơi hòa thuận với Cha
và trở nên tươi trẻ rạng ngời.
Còn đâu than khóc với lo âu.
Chúa ban phước lành dư tràn.
(ĐIỆP KHÚC)
Hát xướng, reo vui trong lòng!
Hướng đến tương lai Cha ban,
ngày ta hân hoan nói trong tâm:
“Sống vui bất tận nay thành!”
3. Mừng biết bao người trên đất nay
cùng sống vui trong cảnh địa đàng;
ngày đêm không ngớt hát khen Cha,
cám ơn đấng tạo muôn loài.
(ĐIỆP KHÚC)
Hát xướng, reo vui trong lòng!
Hướng đến tương lai Cha ban,
ngày ta hân hoan nói trong tâm:

en: SONG 140
LifeWithout End—At Last!
(John 3:16)
1. Can you see with your mind's eye,
Peoples dwelling together?
Sorrow has passed. Peace at last!
Life without tears or pain.
(CHORUS)
Sing out with joy of heart!
You too can have a part.
Live for the day when you'll say,
“Life without end, at last!”
2. In those days all will be young,
All at peace with Jehovah.
Troubles are gone, from now on,
No need to weep or fear.
(CHORUS)
Sing out with joy of heart!
You too can have a part.
Live for the day when you'll say,
“Life without end, at last!”
3. Paradise all will enjoy
As we sing of God's glory.
Long as we live, we will give
Honor and praise to God.
(CHORUS)
Sing out with joy of heart!
You too can have a part.
Live for the day when you'll say,
“Life without end, at last!”
(See also Job 33:25; Ps. 72:7; Rev. 21:4.)

vi: BÀI HÁT 141
l41 Điều kỳ diệu của sự sống
(Thi thiên 56:9)
1. Giọt mưa nhẹ rơi xuống, kìa bao hạt nảy mầm,
bình minh rọi chiếu ngày qua ngày, trẻ thơ cười vui
là bao quà nơi Chúa, tỏ ra bản tính ngài,
tạo nên sự sống, hằng muôn tuyệt tác, ôi quý vô cùng!
Chúng ta luôn biết ơn ngài đã ban cho món quà.
Quý cao thay, ta quyết luôn trân trọng, sống sao vui lòng Cha.
Chẳng chỉ so sánh cho bằng bởi đây quà vô giá thay.
Sự sống là do phép lạ mà Giê-hô-va ban cho.
2. Dù ai sợ gian khó và không còn vững vàng,
tựa như vợ Gióp, họ thay lòng, cách xa đường Cha,
mình theo đường Cha mãi, ngợi khen ngài suốt đời,
từng giây mình sống, tạ ơn ngài đã chăm sóc ân cần.
Chúng ta luôn biết ơn ngài đã ban cho món quà.
Thế nên ta yêu quý, quan tâm người sống ngay bên cạnh ta.
Chẳng chỉ so sánh cho bằng bởi đây quà vô giá thay.
Sự sống là do phép lạ mà Giê-hô-va ban cho.
(Cũng xem Gióp 2:9; Thi 34:12; Truyền 8:15; Mat 22:57-40; Rô 6:25).
ko: 1. 갓 난 새 생명, 영근 곡식알,
이 고귀한 선물 받게 된 우리,
이 생명의 선물, 이 생명의 기적.
살아 숨 쉬는 이 모든 순간
이 고귀한 선물 받게 된 우리,
이 생명의 선물, 이 생명의 기적.
zh_tw: 都是天父的恩典，奇妙珍貴。
朝陽的光輝、澄黃的稻穗，
上帝賜下豐盛恩惠，天天伴隨。
多麼感激上帝賜寶貴生命，
用行動證明我們真心愛戴上帝。
單憑自己努力，無法賺得生命，
感激天父賜予奇妙生命厚禮。
也許像約伯之妻輕看生命。
上帝讓我們活得有意義，
要更努力善用一生讚美上帝。
多麼感激上帝賜寶貴生命，
用行動證明我們真心愛人如己。
單憑自己努力，無法賺得生命，
感激天父賜予奇妙生命厚禮。
en: SONG 141
The Miracle of Life
(Psalm 36:9)
1. Ev'ry newborn child, Ev'ry drop of rain,
Ev'ry golden ray of sun, Each head of grain—
All are gifts from God; They reveal his way.
Miracles performed by him sustain us each day.
So, what are we to do with a gift so rare
But to love the One who gave it and show him we care.
No matter what we do, We never can earn it.
This gift is still a gift—The miracle of life.
2. Others may give up, Lose their will to try,
Echoing the wife of Job: “Curse God and die.”
We are not that way; Praise to God we give,
Thanking him for ev'ry precious moment we live.
So, what are we to do with a gift so rare
But to love the ones around us and show them we care.
No matter what we do, We never can earn it.
This gift is still a gift—The miracle of life.
de: 1. Zart und wunderschön — Morgentau ganz frisch, (Psalm 36:9)
neugebornes kleines Kind, Halme im Licht,
Früchte duftend, süß: Alles ein Geschenk
von Jehova, der an uns so liebevoll denkt.
Den Schöpfer lieben wir, ihm so dankbar sind!
Jeder Tag, jede Minute ist niemals verdient.
Geheimnisvoll und schön: das Wunder des Lebens —
bleibt immer ein Geschenk von dir, Jehova Gott.
2. „Gib doch einfach auf!“, sagte Hiobs Frau.
Doch du willst Jehova ehrn, ihm doch vertrau.
Wir zeigen jeden Tag denen, die uns nah,
dass wir sie von Herzen lieben, wir sind für sie da.
Geheimnisvoll und schön: das Wunder des Lebens —
bleibt immer ein Geschenk von dir, Jehova Gott.
(Siehe auch Hiob 2:9; Ps. 34:12; Pred. 8:15; Mat. 22:37-40; Röm. 6:23.)
fr: 1. L’enfant au berceau, Une goutte d’eau,
Le soleil au point du jour,
Un épi lourd... Sont le don du Dieu Bon et prodigieux
Auprès de qui est la source de toute vie.
Que faire de notre vie ? Qu’y a-t-il de mieux
Que d’aimer le Créateur, lui offrir notre cœur ?
Beau don, cadeau précieux, à personne il n’est dû,
Le grand, le merveilleux miracle de la vie.
S’en prendre à Dieu, le maudire,
Et puis mourir. Ne les suivons pas, Louons Jéhovah.
Disons merci, merci pour chaque instant de vie !
Que faire de notre vie ? Qu’y a-t-il de mieux
Que d’aimer notre prochain, lui ouvrir notre main ?
Beau don, cadeau précieux, à personne il n’est dû,
Le grand, le merveilleux miracle de la vie.
(Voir aussi Job 2:9 ; Ps. 34:12 ; Eccl. 8:15 ; Mat. 22:37-40 ; Rom. 6:23.)
pl: 1. I narodzin cud, i strumyka szum,
promyk słońca w nowy dzień, kłos złotych zbóż —
nasz kochany Bóg wszystko to nam dał.
Tak cudownie stworzył świat i wciąż o nas dba.
Lecz co możemy dać za ten życia dar?
Szczerym sercem kochać Boga, w miłości tej trwać.
Choć wiele możesz mieć, to życia nie kupisz,
bo życie cudem jest — Jehowa nam je dał.
2. Wielu traci sens swoich krótkich dni,
bliskie im, co słyszał Hiob: `Po co ci żyć!’.
Obca nam ta myśl. Chcemy Boga czcić, za bezcenne życia chwile wdzięczni Mu być.
Lecz co możemy dać za ten życia dar?
Szczerym sercem kochać ludzi, w miłości tej trwać.
Choć wiele możesz mieć, to życia nie kupisz,
(Zob. też Hioba 2:9; Ps. 34:12; Kazn. 8:15; Mat. 22:37-40; Rzym. 6:23)
cs: tyto dary nám štědře dává Bůh.
Velkou vděčnost každý cítí za život svůj.
Vždyť žít je nádherné, proto lásku svou
chceme dávat Bohu s vděčností opravdovou.
Je vzácné život mít, je překrásným darem.
Bůh z lásky dal ho nám. Žít je tak zázračné.
My však chceme dál Bohu věrní být,
děkovat mu za každý den, kdy smíme žít.
Vždyť žít je nádherné, proto lásku svou
chceme dávat lidem s radostí opravdovou.
Je vzácné život mít, je překrásným darem.
Bůh z lásky dal ho nám. Žít je tak zázračné.
(Viz také Job 2:9; Žalm 34:12; Kaz. 8:15; Mat. 22:37–40; Řím. 6:23.)
hu: Csoda mindez életünkben nap nap után.
Ó, mondd, az életet hogy köszönjük meg?
Szeretünk, és megbecsüljük a sok-sok szépet.
Kiérdemelni, Jah, ezt senki nem tudja,
az élet ajándék, az életünk csoda.
2. Feladhatják bár, van, ki nem küzd már.
Mi nem így érzünk. Szüntelen áldunk,
minden egyes drága percért hálát adunk.
Ó, mondd, az életet hogy köszönjük meg?
Kiérdemelni, Jah, ezt senki nem tudja,
az élet ajándék, az életünk csoda.
(Lásd még: Jób 2:9; Zsolt 34:12; Préd 8:15; Máté 22:37–40; Róma 6:23.)

朝阳的光辉、澄黄的稻穗，
上帝赐下丰盛恩惠，天天伴随。

1. Trong bao nhiêu năm con người tự đưa bước đường riêng mình
nên bao công lao hư không, tựa mây khói tan tành.

2. Nay muôn dân nghe tin mừng: “Ngày Cha đến gần đây rồi!”.
Mai sau không ai kêu than rằng: “Cho đến bao giờ?”.
Cha ra tay cứu nhân loại hiện nay đang khóc than.
Nào mọi dân hãy đến khen ngợi danh noài.

en: SONG 142
Holding Fast to Our Hope
(Hebrews 6:18, 19)
1. Mankind has stumbled for centuries in darkness.
Vain is their quest as they try to catch the wind.
Man's tragic flaw is revealed in its starkness;
None can they save, for they all have sinned.
(CHORUS)
Sing with good cheer, for God's Kingdom is here!
His Son's mighty reign brings us freedom from fear.
Through him, at last, evil soon will be past;
This hope, like an anchor, is holding us fast.
2. “God's day is near!” rings the Kingdom proclamation;
Men will no longer cry out to God: “How long?”
Soon he will free all his groaning creation.
Praise God Almighty, and join our song.
(CHORUS)
Sing with good cheer, for God's Kingdom is here!
His Son's mighty reign brings us freedom from fear.
Through him, at last, evil soon will be past;
This hope, like an anchor, is holding us fast.
(See also Ps. 27:14; Eccl. 1:14; Joel 2:1; Hab. 1:2, 3; Rom. 8:22.)
ja: 希望をしっかり持ち続ける
de: 1. Traurig und dunkel die menschliche Geschichte.
Suche nach Glück so, als fange man den Wind.
Folgen der Sünde für Menschen sehr tragisch,
tasten nach Hilfe, doch sind wie blind.
Fröhlich stimmt ein, Gottes Reich nur allein
wird uns von der Nacht, ja vom Bösen befrein.
Endlich vorbei sind dann Furcht und auch Leid.
Die Hoffnung ein Anker in stürmischer Zeit.
2. Nah Gottes Tag und sein Königreich, die Hoffnung!
„Wie lange noch?“, niemand klagend dann mehr fragt.
Gott, der Allmächtige, heilt seine Schöpfung.
Dankbar wir sehnen uns nach dem Tag.
Fröhlich stimmt ein, Gottes Reich nur allein
wird uns von der Nacht, ja vom Bösen befrein.

Die Hoffnung ein Anker in stürmischer Zeit.
(Siehe auch Ps. 27:14; Pred. 1:14; Joel 2:1; Hab. 1:2, 3; Röm. 8:22.)
fr: 1. Dans les ténèbres, accablé depuis des siècles,
L’homme se perd à courir après le vent.
« Tous ont péché », et la tare est cruelle,
Prenons courage, le Royaume est en place.
Pour nous délivrer, Jésus Christ est en marche.
Cette espérance est une ancre pour l’âme.
Chantons notre foi ! Attendons dans le calme.
2. Nous proclamons : « Le grand jour de Dieu est proche ! »
Nul, vers les cieux, ne criera plus : « Jusqu’à quand ? »
La liberté va frapper à nos portes.
Gloire au Très-Haut ! Gloire au Tout-Puissant !
Prenons courage, le Royaume est en place.
Pour nous délivrer, Jésus Christ est en marche.
Cette espérance est une ancre pour l’âme.
Chantons notre foi ! Attendons dans le calme.
(Voir aussi Ps. 27:14 ; Eccl. 1:14 ; Joël 2:1 ; Hab. 1:2, 3 ; Rom. 8:22.)
pl: 1. Już od stuleci w ciemnościach ludzie błądzą,
gonią za wiatrem i tracą życia sens.
Jak wiele zła jeszcze sobie wyrządzą?
Kto z nich usunie stąd grzech i śmierć?
Niech z naszych serc płynie ten głośny śpiew:
Gdy przyjdzie czas, Bóg usunie zły świat.
2. Bliski jest dzień, gdy nadejdzie wybawienie.
Smutek i rozpacz przeminą jak zły sen.
Bóg w nas obudził cudowną nadzieję. Sławmy Go razem, śpiewajmy pieśń!
Niech z naszych serc płynie ten głośny śpiew:
Gdy przyjdzie czas, Bóg usunie zły świat.
(Zob. też Ps. 27:14; Kazn. 1:14; Joela 2:1; Hab. 1:2, 3; Rzym. 8:22)
cs: 1. Tmou klopýtá lidstvo po staletí dlouhá,
stále se jen marně honí za větrem.
Žít šťastně je veliká lidská touha.
Žij s radostí, vládne nám Království!
To z pout strachu nás navždycky vyprostí.
Náš mocný Král všechno zlé odstraní.
Ten dar naděje mocně nás upevní.
2. Dávno se ptal prorok, špatností se trápil:
„Jak dlouho mám volat, než mě uslyšíš?“
Den Jehovův brzy mír zemi vrátí.
Žij s radostí, vládne nám Království!

Látjuk, a bűnnek mily súlyos a terhe,
Nézz fel, hisz Isten királysága áll!
Örülj, nem lesz félelem, Jézus király!
2. Elmondjuk bátran, hogy jön Jehova napja.

véget vet ő a sok bánatnak, kínnak.

KeepWorking, Watching, and Waiting
(Romans 8:20-25)
1. The God of times and of seasons,
Whose name alone is Jehovah—
The time for his vindication
Is near by signs we can see.
(CHORUS)
Keep on working and watching and waiting,
Joyfully anticipating,
Life as God meant it to be.
2. The time has long been appointed;
His Son is ready to conquer,
Defeating all who oppose him.
His sword will bring victory.
(CHORUS)
Keep on working and watching and waiting,
Joyfully anticipating,
Life as God meant it to be.
3. Though all creation is groaning,
In faith we're eagerly waiting.
Jehovah's day is approaching,
The time for setting us free.
(CHORUS)
Keep on working and watching and waiting,
Joyfully anticipating,
Life as God meant it to be.
(See also Matt. 25:13; Luke 12:36.)

Hãy đặt phần thưởng trước mặt luôn!
(2 Cô-rinh-tô 4:18)
1. Mọi người điếc mừng rỡ nay nghe trở lại.
Người mù sẽ nhìn thấy ngàn ánh ban mai.
Bao tiếng hát trẻ thơ rộn vang đây đó.
Khắp chốn an vui, điệu nhạc hân hoan.
Địa cầu chẳng còn cảnh đau thương, lệ nhòa.
Người đã khuất được sống lại với thân nhân.
(ĐIỆP KHÚC)
Ta sẽ thấy tương lai huy hoàng trên đất,
nếu ta đặt phần thưởng trước mặt luôn.
2. Kìa bầy gấu sưởi nắng bên cạnh đàn bò,
và cừu sẽ cùng sói đùa giỡn, ăn chung.
Khi đứa bé tung tăng chạy chơi với chúng,
chúng bước đi theo lời gọi thơ ngây.
Vào ngày ấy nào thấy than van, buồn rầu;

(ĐIỆP KHÚC)

en: SONG 144
KeepYour Eyes on the Prize!
(2 Corinthians 4:18)
1. When the eyes of blind ones see again
And the ears of deaf ones hear again,
When the songs of children fill the air
And joy and peace are ev'rywhere,
When our loved ones will return to life,
To an earth that's free from sin and strife,
(CHORUS)
You will see how God these things supplies,
If you keep your eyes on the prize.
2. When the wolves and lambs will feed as one,
When the bears and calves bask in the sun,
Then a mere young boy will lead them all,
And they will heed his childish call.
When our tears belong to yesterday,
When our fears and pain have passed away,
(CHORUS)
You will see how God these things supplies,
If you keep your eyes on the prize.
de: 1. Wenn der Blinde Farben sehen kann,
wenn der Taube Lieder hören kann,
jedes Kind dann freudig lacht und springt,
Wenn die Auferweckten du dann siehst,
deine Lieben in die Arme schließt.
Unser Gott verspricht uns diese Zeit.
Schau fest auf das Ziel! Sei bereit!
2. Friedlich weiden sieht man Wolf und Lamm,
sogar Bär und Löwe werden zahm.
Und ein kleiner Junge führt sie fort,
sie hören willig auf sein Wort.
jedes Herz von Leid und Angst befreit.
Unser Gott verspricht uns diese Zeit.
Schau fest auf das Ziel! Sei bereit!
fr: Fixons nos regards sur le prix !
1. Quand l’aveugle enfin aura la vue,
Quand le sourd dira « j’entends ! », ému,
Quand l’enfant rira dans l’air léger,
La joie, la paix de tous côtés,
Quand se lèveront nos êtres chers
Dans un monde sans péché ni guerre...
Fixons nos regards sur le prix !
2. Quand le loup boira près de l’agneau,
Que l’ourson jouera avec le veau,
Un petit garçon pour les guider,
Sa jeune voix pour les mener,
Quand surtout les larmes vont tarir,

Lời hứa của Đức Chúa Trời về địa đàng
1. Cha Giê-hô-va đã hứa làm đất nên
như vườn Ê-đen nhờ Nước của Cha.
Trong một ngàn năm, tội lỗi, chết chóc hay
đau đớn, đắng cay ngài xóa muôn đời.
(ĐIỆP KHÚC)
Địa đàng Cha hứa nay đã đến gần;
bằng đức tin mạnh, mình thấy rõ ràng.
Lời xưa Cha phán, Con chắc sẽ làm;
ngài thích thị hành ý Giê-hô-va.
2. Theo lệnh của Cha, người mất từ bấy lâu
sống lại nay mai cùng với thân nhân.

“Anh ở với tôi tại chốn địa đàng”.

God's Promise of Paradise
1. A paradise our God has promised,
By means of Christ's Millennial Reign,
When he'll blot out all sin and error,
Removing death and tears and pain.
(CHORUS)
A paradise, the earth will be.
With eyes of faith, this we can see.
This promise Christ will soon fulfill,
For he delights to do God's will.
2. Soon here on earth, as God has purposed,
His Son will cause the dead to rise.
Then it will be as Jesus promised:
‘You'll be with me in Paradise.'
(CHORUS)
A paradise, the earth will be.
With eyes of faith, this we can see.
This promise Christ will soon fulfill,
For he delights to do God's will.
3. The Paradise, our Lord has promised,
And he is now our reigning King.
We daily thank our loving Father,
And from our hearts, his praises sing.
(CHORUS)
A paradise, the earth will be.
With eyes of faith, this we can see.
This promise Christ will soon fulfill,
For he delights to do God's will.
(See also Matt. 5:5; 6:10; John 5:28, 29.)

zh_tw: 基督在榮耀寶座上登基。
撒但被驅逐，天上已潔淨，
上帝旨意將在地上實行。
世上不會再有死亡、痛苦，
人人歡欣快樂，不再哀哭。
上帝說：「現在我更新一切！」
基督新娘發出萬丈光芒。
她披金戴玉來迎接新郎，
她的榮光全來自耶和華。
世上不會再有死亡、痛苦，
人人歡欣快樂，不再哀哭。
上帝說：「現在我更新一切！」
城門不分晝夜永遠敞開。
上帝忠僕反映聖城榮光，
萬國將歸向這燦爛光芒。
世上不會再有死亡、痛苦，
人人歡欣快樂，不再哀哭。
上帝說：「現在我更新一切！」
en: SONG 146
“Making All Things New”
(Revelation 21:1-5)
1. “The signs of the times” prove God's rule has begun.
In glory enthroned sits Jehovah's Son.
The heavens are cleansed, Satan's now debased,
And soon on the earth let God's will take place.
(CHORUS)
Rejoice! For God's tent is with men,
And he himself resides with them.
No more will there be pain or worrying,
No sting of death nor any sorrowing.
For God has said: ‘I'm making all things new.'
These words faithful are and true.
2. Let all men the pure New Jerusalem see,
The bride of the Lamb shining radiantly.
Adorned for her husband in gems so bright,
And only Jehovah will be her light.
(CHORUS)
Rejoice! For God's tent is with men,
And he himself resides with them.
No more will there be pain or worrying,
No sting of death nor any sorrowing.
For God has said: ‘I'm making all things new.'
These words faithful are and true.
3. This city so grand will become a delight.
Its gates will be open both day and night.
The nations will walk in her glory bright;
The servants of God now reflect that light.
(CHORUS)
Rejoice! For God's tent is with men,
And he himself resides with them.
No more will there be pain or worrying,
No sting of death nor any sorrowing.
For God has said: ‘I'm making all things new.'
These words faithful are and true.
ja: 「全てのものを新しくしている」

dass schon Gottes Sohn zu regiern begann.
Im Himmel besiegte er Satan dann.
Bald hier Gottes Wille geschehen kann.
Wie schön, bei Menschen Gottes Zelt!
Bei uns zu wohnen ihm gefällt.
Kein Mensch wird mehr von Schmerz und Tod geplagt,
Ja, Gott verspricht: „Ich mache alles neu.“
Er hält immer Wort, ist treu.
2. Das Neue Jerusalem heilig und rein,
die Braut Christi strahlt hell wie Sonnenschein.
Ihr festlicher Schmuck ist aus Edelstein.
Jehova, ihr Gott, ist ihr Licht allein.
Wie schön, bei Menschen Gottes Zelt!
Bei uns zu wohnen ihm gefällt.
Kein Mensch wird mehr von Schmerz und Tod geplagt,
Ja, Gott verspricht: „Ich mache alles neu.“
Er hält immer Wort, ist treu.
3. Die Stadt leuchtet allen in herrlicher Pracht,
die Tore geöffnet bei Tag und Nacht.
Im Licht können alle Nationen sein.
Wir spiegeln es wider, ob groß, ob klein.
Wie schön, bei Menschen Gottes Zelt!
Bei uns zu wohnen ihm gefällt.
Kein Mensch wird mehr von Schmerz und Tod geplagt,
Ja, Gott verspricht: „Ich mache alles neu.“
Er hält immer Wort, ist treu.

Ni deuil, ni cri, ni larme ne sont plus,

Life Everlasting Is Promised
(Psalm 37:29)
1. Life everlasting is promised.
Our earthly home will endure.
‘Meek ones will thrive,' said the psalmist.
This grand future is sure.
(CHORUS)
We can live forever.
It's worth all endeavor.
God's promise is faithful.
His Word will come true.
2. Paradise brought to perfection;
All of God's children set free.
Under Jehovah's direction,
Peace on earth we will see.
(CHORUS)
We can live forever.
It's worth all endeavor.
God's promise is faithful.
His Word will come true.
3. Soon in the grand resurrection,
Sorrow will all disappear.
Showering tender affection,
God will dry ev'ry tear.
(CHORUS)
We can live forever.
It's worth all endeavor.
God's promise is faithful.
His Word will come true.
(See also Isa. 25:8; Luke 23:43; John 11:25; Rev. 21:4.)

en: SONG 148
Jehovah Provides Escape
(2 Samuel 22:1-8)
1. The living God, Jehovah, you have proved to be;
Your mighty works abound
in earth and sky and sea.
No rival god can equal what you have done
—there is none.
Our foes will be consumed.
(CHORUS)
Jehovah provides escape for the loyal.
His servants will see what a mighty Crag is he.
So with courage and faith in our God,
we spread the fame
Of Jehovah, our Source of escape,
and praise his name.
2. Though ropes of death encircle me, I call to you,
“Jehovah, give me strength,
and give me courage too.”
From your own temple dwelling, you hear my plea,
“Shelter me;
Rescue me, O my God.”
(CHORUS)
Jehovah provides escape for the loyal.
His servants will see what a mighty Crag is he.
So with courage and faith in our God,
we spread the fame
Of Jehovah, our Source of escape,
and praise his name.
3. From heaven you will thunder
and give forth your voice.
Your enemies will quake;
your servants will rejoice.
You prove to be whatever you need to be;
all will see
How you provide escape.
(CHORUS)
Jehovah provides escape for the loyal.
His servants will see what a mighty Crag is he.
So with courage and faith in our God,
Of Jehovah, our Source of escape,
and praise
his name.

en: SONG 149
AVictory Song
(Exodus 15:1)
1. Sing to Jehovah. His great name is highly exalted.
His proud Egyptian foes, He has cast into the sea.
Praise Jah Almighty;
Besides him there can be no other.
Jehovah is his name;
He has gained the victory.
Jehovah God, Most High over all,
(CHORUS)
The one who is forevermore the same,
You soon will cause your enemies to fall
And sanctify your holy name.
2. See now all nations Opposing the Sov'reign, Jehovah.
Though mightier than Pharaoh,
They too will suffer shame.
Judgment awaits them;
They cannot escape Armageddon.
Soon ev'ryone will know
That Jehovah is God's name.
(CHORUS)
The one who is forevermore the same,
You soon will cause your enemies to fall
And sanctify your holy name.

en: SONG 150
Seek God for Your Deliverance
(Zephaniah 2:3)
1. Nations align as one,
Opposing Jehovah's Son.
Their time of human rulership
By God's decree now is done.
Rulers have had their day;
God's Kingdom is here to stay.
Soon Christ will crush earthly enemies.
No more will there be delay.
(CHORUS)
Seek God for your deliverance,
Yes, look to him with confidence.
Seek his righteousness,
Show your faithfulness,
For his sov'reignty, take your stand.
Then see our God deliver you
By his mighty hand.
2. People on earth now choose,
Responding to this good news.
We offer to all men the choice
To hear or proudly refuse.
Trials, although severe,
Need not fill our hearts with fear.
Jehovah cares for his loyal ones;
Our cries for help he will hear.
(CHORUS)
Seek God for your deliverance,
Yes, look to him with confidence.
Seek his righteousness,
Show your faithfulness,
For his sov'reignty, take your stand.
Then see our God deliver you
By his mighty hand.
(See also 1 Sam. 2:9; Ps. 2:2, 3, 9; Prov. 2:8; Matt. 6:33.)

Chúa sẽ gọi
1. Như màn sương sớm hiện rồi tan trong phút chốc,

en: SONG 151
He Will Call
1. Life, like a mist, appears for just a day,
Then disappears tomorrow.
All that we are can quickly fade away,
Replaced with tears and sorrow.
If a man should die, can he live again?
Hear the promise God has made:
(CHORUS)
He will call; The dead will answer.
They will live at his command.
For he will have a longing
For the work of his own hand.
So have faith, and do not wonder,
For our God can make us stand.
And we will live forever,
As the work of his own hand.
2. Friends of our God, though they may pass away,
Will never be forsaken.
All those asleep who in God's mem'ry stay,
From death he will awaken.
Then we'll come to see all that life can be:
Paradise eternally.
(CHORUS)
He will call; The dead will answer.
They will live at his command.
For he will have a longing
For the work of his own hand.
So have faith, and do not wonder,
For our God can make us stand.
And we will live forever,
As the work of his own hand.

2. Pour les amis du Dieu des vivants,

Au beau jour de la relève,

Một nơi mang lại ngợi khen cho Cha
(1 Các vua 8:27; 1 Sử ký 29:14)
1. Lạy Cha, ngự ngôi thánh cao trọng trên trời,
thần dân ngài trên đất đang hết tâm
dựng xây các công trình ngợi khen danh thánh,

Mọi dân cùng nhau đến nơi này bao ngày
hầu nghe lời khôn ngoan, thông sáng thay.
Cùng hợp nhất ca tụng, thờ tôn Cha mãi,
chúng con mong luôn làm Cha mừng vui.
(ĐOẠN CHUYỂN)
Điều Cha đã nhân từ ban
nhiều vô số không gì so sánh.
Giờ dâng hiến cho ngài bao điều
cũng do tay ngài cung cấp.
(ĐIỆP KHÚC)
Thành tâm tạ ơn đấng ban mọi ơn lành,
dội vang lời ca hát dâng đến Cha.
Điều ao ước bấy lâu giờ ngay trước mắt.
Chính nơi đây mang lại bao ngợi khen.
2. Mừng vui vì mong ước bao ngày nay thành,
một nơi làm danh thánh thêm hiển vinh.
Nhà Cha giúp bao người thờ phượng chân chính
đến tôn vinh và học theo lối Cha.
Giờ đây nguyện dâng hiến nơi này cho ngài.
Hằng mong ngài ban phước cho chúng con
hầu hăng hái thi hành mọi việc nhanh chóng
đúng theo như Con ngài giao thuở xưa.
(ĐOẠN CHUYỂN)
Nguyện dâng Chúa bao thời gian
hoặc vật chất, năng lực, tri thức.
Vật chi tốt dâng trọn cho ngài,
đấng ban muôn điều cao quý.
(ĐIỆP KHÚC)
Thành tâm tạ ơn đấng ban mọi ơn lành,

en: SONG 152
A Place That Will Bring You Praise
(1 Kings 8:27; 1 Chronicles 29:14)
1.  Jehovah, the Maker of heaven,
By heaven you can't be contained,
Even less an earthly dwelling place.
But your spirit can here remain.
Adorning this center of worship
Are people who walk in your light.
We rejoice to serve in unity;
Our devotion is your delight.
(BRIDGE)
There is nothing we have
That you haven't provided.
From your own hand, we've given
All that we offer you.
(CHORUS)
For all you have done, we are grateful;
Our voices in song we now raise.
For you've made our hope reality
With this place that will bring you praise.
2.  Jehovah, you knew that we wanted
A place that will bring to you praise
And will serve the needs of worshippers,
Helping others to walk your ways.
And now may this place serve your purpose.
There's work needing yet to be done,
To pick up the pace and carry on
In the work given by your Son.
(BRIDGE)
So we offer the best
Of our time and possessions.
You alone are deserving—
Giver of all good things.
(CHORUS)
For all you have done, we are grateful;
Our voices in song we now raise.
For you've made our hope reality
With this place that will bring you praise.

de: Ein Ort, der dich ehrt und preist
an dich reichen sie nicht heran.
doch dein Geist hier verbleiben kann.
Der Schmuck dieses Hauses sind Menschen,
die wandeln im Licht immer mehr.
Und in Einheit dienen wir dir gern,
Da ist nichts aus uns selbst,
So dankbar für all deine Güte
wir singen ein Lied nur für dich.
Du gibst Hoffnung uns durch dieses Haus,
das dich ehrt und dich preist fortan.
2. Jehova, ein Haus wir uns wünschten,
das Ehre dir bringt und dich preist
und das Menschen hilft zu wandeln gern
in den Wegen, die du uns weist.
So diene dies Haus deinem Vorsatz.
Viel Arbeit zu tun, steht jetzt an.
In dem Werk, das du durch Christus gabst,
So dankbar für all deine Güte,
wir singen ein Lied nur für dich.
Du gibst Hoffnung uns durch dieses Haus,
das dich ehrt und dich preist fortan.

en: SONG 153
Give Me Courage
(2 Kings 6:16)
1. Doubt and fear surround me—
The way ahead not clear.
Through uncertainty you guide me;
I know you're always near.
Life may not be easy,
But this I know is true:
You're the God who's ever loyal;
My life is safe with you.
(CHORUS)

There are more with us than against us.
Courageous let me be.
Courage, give me courage;

Your victory is sure.

Lasting harm can never hold me—

Unfailing Love
(1 Corinthians 13:8)
1. Look around us now;
See the love on each face—
Out there in the world, hard to find.
All these faithful friends
With the love they all show,
Glad to leave that old world behind.
(PRE-CHORUS)
Love never fails; that's promised.
It always will endure.
(CHORUS)
Love—unfailing love—
That's what Jehovah gives.
That's what he is.

And the love here today,
In our heart may it stay—
Unfailing love.
2. Though sometimes it seems

Weigh us down and feel hard to bear,

Comforted by God's loving care.

(Psalm 16:11)

en: SONG 158
“It Will Not Be Late!”
(Habakkuk 2:3)
1. Beauty fills the earth,
wonder fills our mind—
The work of your hands
so patiently designed.
Though the world may change,
you remain the same.
You patiently wait
to make it new again.
(CHORUS)
Father, we long to see
Paradise come to be.
Give us the patience to wait.
We know your day will come,
sure as the rising sun.
No matter how long it takes,
“It will not be late!”
2. Faithfully we wait
for the dead to rise.
Jehovah, you yearn
to bring them back to life.
Father, we well know
how you loved them so.
Instill in our hearts
the patience you have shown.
(CHORUS)
Father, we long to see
Paradise come to be.
Give us the patience to wait.
We know your day will come,
sure as the rising sun.
No matter how long it takes,
“It will not be late!”
3. Patiently you search;
honest hearts you find.
You heal them with hope
and long to give them life.
Working by your side,
We use our time well.
It draws us close to you.
(CHORUS)
Father, we long to see
Paradise come to be.
Give us the patience to wait.
We know your day will come,
sure as the rising sun.
No matter how long it takes,
“It will not be late!”
Father, please
help us to wait!
(See also Col. 1:11.)

en: SONG 159
Give Jehovah Glory
(Psalm 96:8)
1. Who is like you, O Jehovah,
High on your heavenly throne?
How could I ever repay you
For all of the love you have shown?
When I look up to the heavens,
Power and glory I see.
Who then am I, O Jehovah,
That you would show favor to me?
(CHORUS)
Jehovah God, please hear the song I sing.
It's a song of praise to you.
You are my God and the Eternal King,
So I give you what is due;
All the glory goes to you.
2. My life is yours, O Jehovah.
May all I do bring you praise.
Gladly I'll speak of your goodness
And tell of your glorious ways.
Serving you, Great God, Jehovah,
Fills me with honor and pride.
You are my strength and my glory.
Forever may you be my Guide.
(CHORUS)
Jehovah God, please hear the song I sing.
It's a song of praise to you.
You are my God and the Eternal King,
So I give you what is due;
All the glory goes to you.
3. Oceans and valleys below me,
Sun, moon, and stars up above
Fill me with joy and with wonder
And show me your unending love.
Majesty, wisdom, and beauty:
These are the things that I see.
How could I not give you glory
For making it all come to be?
(CHORUS)
It's a song of praise to you.
You are my God and the Eternal King,
So I give
you what is due;
All the glory goes to you.

zh_cn: 来听听他说该怎样去生活:
乐意原谅人，努力将心比心。
耶和华知道我们需要什么。
他爱护花朵，一定会更爱我。
如同一间房，建造在岩石上。
美好的生命，从现在到永恒。
